recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source fix is needed for FHIR-26067; any future cleanup of the stale capabilitystatement XML copy should be treated as generated-artifact/tooling maintenance, not the normative issue fix.
issue_request: FHIR-26067 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to add two-part major.minor FHIR-version codes as parents of corresponding longer version codes, while updating versions.html and the fhirVersion MIME parameter text from publication/major/minor/revision language to major/minor/patch terminology.
initial_application: Git commit 6f6a8881881a31a2ec13ae9d185200556d161b53 explicitly applied FHIR-26067 together with FHIR-35168 by adding the major.minor hierarchy to the FHIRVersion CodeSystem and updating source/versions.html, source/versioning.html, and source/http.html.
additional_context: FHIR-35168 is the same-change-family terminology cleanup applied in the same commit. FHIR-35169 was later Resolved - No Change because FHIR-26067 already addressed the fhirVersion value-set concern. A Zulip committers thread confirms the master for the FHIR-version CodeSystem is source/terminologies/bindings.xml; the checked-in source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-FHIR-version.xml copy is stale and not the source of truth for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/terminologies/bindings.xml already has major.minor parents for the current 4.6, 5.0, and 6.0 version families; source/versions.html and source/http.html already use the requested terminology; and build.fhir.org's generated CodeSystem matches the worksheet.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same commit and supplied the major.minor.patch-label terminology cleanup that FHIR-26067 relies on.
Resolved - No Change because the fhirVersion binding concern was already addressed by FHIR-26067.
